name: systematic-review
description: Reproducible systematic-search and screening workflow with explicit eligibility criteria, stable record deduplication, and an auditable decision trail.

interface.shortDescription: Run a traceable systematic search and screening process.
interface.longDescription: Defines eligibility and search boundaries, deduplicates records, preserves screening decisions, and reports coverage without claiming inaccessible databases were searched.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me define and run a reproducible systematic-review workflow.
